title: Cabinet Approves ₹1 Lakh Crore Urban Challenge Fund (UCF)
summary: UCF provides ₹1 lakh crore central assistance to catalyze ₹4 lakh crore total urban infrastructure investment.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Approves ₹1 Lakh Crore Urban Challenge Fund (UCF). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Union Cabinet approved the **₹1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund (UCF)** operating under a 25:25:50 funding model (Centre 25%, State/ULB 25%, Market 50%).
